title: Undeclared hard dependency on another module
note: Superseded by Check_Dependencies PHP class (v1.3.0). Kept as placeholder to reserve the rule_id.
description: Code uses require/require_once/include/include_once to load files from another module's directory, or calls GetModuleInstance()/get_module() without a null check. If the referenced module is not installed and not declared in GetDependencies(), this causes a fatal error at runtime.
